basic_info.description: Huge price improvement! Charming 4-Unit Apartment Building Near Dolores Park    This well-maintained 4-unit apartment building offers an excellent investment opportunity in a prime location just a few blocks from the iconic Dolores Park. The entire building spans 3,155 sq ft and includes an attached 3-car garage, providing ample parking or additional storage. One unit is currently vacant and ready for immediate occupancy. Each unit features 2 spacious bedrooms, 1 modern bathroom, and the convenience of in-unit laundry.    Perfect for those looking to own a home while generating monthly income from tenants, this property offers both comfort and financial potential. The property is nestled in a vibrant neighborhood with easy access to local cafes, shops, and public transportation. Whether you're looking to occupy the vacant unit or rent it out, this property provides a unique opportunity to live and invest in one of the city's most desirable areas. Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity!
